question: Where was the first Asian Games held in 1951?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi, India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **first Asian Games were held in New Delhi, India in 1951**
 
• It was **Held on March 8–11, 1951** 
 
• It was held in **Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium,** also known as the National Stadium 
 
• **489 athletes from 11 Asian countries competed in 57 events across eight sports,** including association football, athletics, basketball, cycling, swimming, and weightlifting 
 
• **Japan won the most medals with 24 golds and 60 total medals,** while India came in second with 15 golds and 51 total medals 
 
• The **second Asian Games were held in Manila, Philippines in 1954 **
 
• New Delhi hosted the Asian Games again in 1982
